name: phantomworld-vps
install: if [ ! -d CFX-Developer-Tools ]; then git clone https://github.com/TMHSDigital/CFX-Developer-Tools.git; fi && pip install -r CFX-Developer-Tools/mcp-server/requirements.txt --quiet && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq openssh-client sshpass tmux && chmod +x tools/vps/*.sh
start: echo 'Phantom World VPS deploy ready. Run: bash tools/vps/deploy-from-agent.sh'
